title: CS: Customer Requests Compilation (Apr 2025)
summary: Synthesis of customer feedback gathered between 2025-03-20 and 2025-04-08 from 18 interviews (enterprise, mid-market, AI-native startups), 42 survey responses, and three technical onboarding sessions. This memo groups recurring asks, highlights severity for production use cases, and proposes candidate solutions and owners. Goal: provide product + eng a prioritized, actionable backlog for Q2 planning and to surface items that must feed into Dedicated/Private roadmaps.
methodology: Combined qualitative notes + frequency scoring. Each mention counted once per customer; we de-duplicated variant phrasing. Severity assigned by customer impact (P0: blocking/major SLA cost; P1: high friction; P2: nice-to-have). Cross-checked with CS support tickets (Mar 2025) for corroboration.
pain_points: Token-level cost attribution is opaque — customers want per-route and per-session breakdowns to charge internal teams.
Autoscaling behavior for Dedicated pools is unpredictable under bursty traffic — customers fear throttling during peak business hours.
Private deployment networking and onboarding docs are sparse — infra teams need clearer VPC examples and troubleshooting steps.
Model fallback behavior across variants can cause semantic drift; customers want deterministic downgrade paths with quality guarantees.
Streaming interruptions and partial responses on long outputs — retry semantics unclear and SDKs lack simple resumable consumers.
Limited guidance for quantization/latency tradeoffs per workload — customers waste time tuning in prod.
Rollout and canary tooling lacks fine-grained routing rules (by customer, by route, by latency) for staged releases.
Audit logs and KMS integration for Private deployments require clearer templates for compliance reviewers.
Lack of standard eval hooks to tie quality regressions to releases — customers want regression alerts tied to test prompts.
feature_requests: [P0] Per-route token & cost breakdown in Console + API export (CSV/JSON) so finance can bill internal teams directly.
[P0] Deterministic model-fallback policies: explicit fallback chains with SLO/quality thresholds and opt-in A/B logging.
[P0] Dedicated autoscale SLA improvements: configurable min/max pool sizes, warm pool options, and burst credits visibility.
[P1] Streaming resilience primitives in SDKs: resumable streams, chunk sequencing, and client-side retry helpers.
[P1] Private deployment VPC templates and a troubleshooting playbook (common ports, iptables, peering examples).
[P1] Console feature: per-model inference profiles showing latency/cost by sequence-length distribution and suggested quantization level.
[P2] Rolling preview routes: allow 5% of traffic to new model variant with automatic rollback on regression signals.
[P2] SDK examples for typed function-calling patterns in several languages (Python, TS, Go) with validation helpers.
[P2] Eval-driven alerts: tie curated prompt sets to deployments and trigger signals when model outputs diverge beyond threshold.
[P2] Multi-region routing preference per customer with failover order and cost-aware routing rules.
representative_quotes: "We need to know which product lines are eating tokens — otherwise we have to eat the bill." — CPO at B2B SaaS customer
"During marketing launches we see a sudden burst and the Dedicated pool seems to choke — that unpredictability is scary." — Infra lead, retail platform
"The private deploy docs assume we already know how to wire up transit gateways — our security team needs an end-to-end example." — Platform engineer, healthcare customer
"When the model falls back it sometimes returns completely different wording; we need a safety net so UX doesn't break." — PM, conversational assistant startup
prioritized_actions: Ship per-route token/cost export (MVP CSV) — owner: Product Analytics, target: 2025-05-22
Define model-fallback spec with compatibility matrix and implement opt-in chain behavior — owner: Serving Runtime, target: 2025-06-12
Pilot Dedicated warm-pool option with two customers, measure launch latency under burst — owner: Infra Eng, target: 2025-05-30
Draft Private deployment VPC cookbook and troubleshooting doc — owner: Solutions Eng, target: 2025-05-08
Add resumable streaming helpers to Python/TS SDKs and document retry semantics — owner: Developer Experience, target: 2025-06-01

Create Jira epic CSREQ-3421 to track per-route cost work and link customer examples (owner: Maya)
Schedule technical working session with two high-volume customers to define autoscale SLOs (by 2025-04-25)
Add regression prompt set for top-5 customers to evaluation pipeline and enable weekly quality diffs (owner: Applied ML)

uncategorized_notes: A few minor asks repeatedly surfaced: nicer default SDK error messages, small sample rate-limiter for dev mode, and example invoices showing per-team cost splits. We should capture these in a low-priority backlog bucket. Several customers offered to be references for new console features if we include them in early pilots.
